text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends that Belinda Square, Sandyhook Square and Sylvestre Square be designated as through highways in order to clearly define the right-of-way and to regulate traffic flow for the three subject uncontrolled P-Loop intersections.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Designated Belinda Square, between Wintermute Boulevard and a point 150 metres east, as a through highway. 2. Designated Sandyhook Square, between Wintermute Boulevard and a point 150 metres east, as a through highway. 3. Designated Sylvestre Square, between Wintermute Boulevard and a point 100 metres east, as a through highway.
